title: Naga Hammadi aluminum workers sit in over the unified HR regulation and production bonus
location: Egypt Aluminum Complex, Naga Hammadi, Qena Governorate
participants_original: Cairo24 and Al-Dostor say hundreds; DARB/Center for Trade Union and Workers Services gives no count; Al-Araby search result says dozens
threshold_50_evidence: Two opened contemporary reports describe hundreds of workers in the same local sit-in, above 50; a search-only Al-Araby snippet describes dozens, so attendance remains a qualitative and source-disputed estimate.

start_date.summary: Cairo24 dates article and action to Nov 12; DARB and Al-Dostor say Thursday Nov 12.

location.summary: Naga Hammadi Aluminum Factory/Complex, Qena Governorate.

demands.summary: Workers oppose Law 203/unified HR regulation and seek full annual profit/production bonus.

participants.summary: Two opened reports say hundreds; search-only Al-Araby snippet says dozens; no bounded numeric count.

threshold_50.summary: Both Cairo24 and Al-Dostor use “hundreds” for the same action; the precise attendance estimate is not available.

state_target.summary: The disputed HR rules stem from Ministry of Public Business Sector / Law 203; factory is in the public business sector.

end_date.summary: Al-Dostor headline/lead says ended; later sentence says workers insisted on remaining. Endpoint unresolved.

notes: Single Naga Hammadi sit-in/partial work stoppage on Nov 12 over government Law 203/unified HR regulation and profit/bonus payment. Do not split sit-in and strike into separate events. Al-Dostor body conflicts about whether sit-in ended; no end date assigned.
